2607.14661.title: SmartRAG: Native Graph-Based RAG for Mobile Device
2607.14661.paper_summary: Deploying large language models (LLMs) as personal assistants on mobile devices demands privacy, low latency, and offline availability, yet the computational cost of giant models clashes with strict edge-hardware budgets. We argue that this tension cannot be resolved by model compression alone; it requires decomposing on-device intelligence into complementary functional roles. We present SmartRAG, a fully on-device framework that organizes an intelligent assistant around four coordinated modules -- Perception, Memory, Focus, and Thinking. At the core of SmartRAG is EvoNER, a continually learnable named-entity recognizer that incrementally expands its label inventory through teacher-distilled updates, enabling the system to absorb previously unseen entity types without retraining the backbone LLM. Extracted knowledge is stored in MRGraph, a three-layer provenance-preserving knowledge graph, and retrieved at query time through a hybrid pipeline combining graph traversal, lexical matching, and dense semantic search. The on-device LLM is invoked only for high-value semantic operations -- labeling, planning, and answer synthesis -- keeping inference costs bounded. Experiments on four QA benchmarks (TriviaQA, Natural Questions, HotpotQA, MultiHopQA) show that SmartRAG with a quantized 1.7B-parameter backbone achieves multi-hop reasoning performance competitive with models up to 18$\times$ larger, while running entirely on commodity smartphones within practical memory and latency envelopes.
2607.14661.paper_summary_zh: 部署大型語言模型（LLMs）作為移動設備上的個人助理需要隱私、低延遲和離線可用性，但巨型模型的計算成本與嚴格的邊緣硬體預算相衝突。我們認為，這種緊張關係不能僅通過模型壓縮來解決；它需要將設備上的智能分解為互補的功能角色。我們提出了SmartRAG，一個完全在設備上運行的框架，圍繞四個協調模塊組織智能助理——感知、記憶、專注和思考。SmartRAG的核心是EvoNER，一個持續可學習的命名實體識別器，通過教師蒸餾更新逐步擴展其標籤庫，使系統能夠吸收以前未見的實體類型，而無需重新訓練主幹LLM。提取的知識存儲在MRGraph中，這是一個三層的保留來源的知識圖譜，並在查詢時通過結合圖遍歷、詞彙匹配和密集語義搜索的混合管道檢索。僅在高價值語義操作——標記、規劃和答案合成時調用設備上的LLM，從而保持推理成本的界限。在四個QA基準（TriviaQA、Natural Questions、HotpotQA、MultiHopQA）上的實驗表明，使用量化的1.7B參數主幹的SmartRAG實現了與高達18$\times$更大模型競爭的多跳推理性能，同時完全在商品智能手機上運行，符合實際的內存和延遲範圍。
